entries.title: full-06's phone audio was read 30 s late: Balloon Boy parts from the host by 15 s, not at 40 s
entries.body: The audio reader paired each mask-sound onset with the nearest rebuild play within 1 s, which assumes the capture starts at game 0; it starts before the night, and the mask sound repeats every 10 s window, so the 2026-09-28 read fit three windows late. Solved over the rebuild's monitor and mask plays, the opening's five sounds (2.53 to 5.43 s) land within 0.04 s of their plays, and the capture's own start and stop stamps admit only that offset. On the corrected clock the phone's Balloon Boy hop vocals are at 10.04, 15.08 and 20.04 s, every one just after a 5 s roll; at 15.03 s the rebuild plays echo1 where the phone plays echo3b, so the two draw streams differ at or before 15 s, and the weaker 10.04 s read, where the rebuild moves him from CAM 10 silently, puts the difference at his first roll, at 5 s. The frame-trace input registration of the corrected entry stands: the phone's hall flash ends 3 to 5 updates before the replayed hall release, monitor raises land within -2..+1 updates and mask presses within 0..-1. The reader now refuses an offset that another offset fits nearly as well.
entries.label: DEVICE_MEASURED

entries.title: No office start state reproduces full-06; its strong fits share the same misses
entries.body: Pre-registered before any state but the measured seed was replayed: every one of the 65,536 office start states through the production model on full-06's own measured clock and landed contacts, scored against the phone's 42 eyehole-read mask windows. The measured seed agrees through window 6, no better than 26,557 others; no state agrees past window 23, three tie there, and start states up to 12 draws from the seed never reach window 10. By the predeclared rule that is INCONCLUSIVE, not an identified seed. The strong states miss the same windows: the two the phone reads as Withered Freddy (22 and 26), and a one-window slip of the B-then-C rhythm at 31-32. Misses every start state shares come from the mechanics or the inputs, not the seed.
entries.label: MODEL_ONLY

entries.title: At its measured seed, no single change before Balloon Boy's first roll reproduces full-06's opening
entries.body: Pre-registered: each of the nine contacts before the first mask press shifted -3..+3 updates or removed, and one or two draws added or removed after any of the first 301 updates, 1,267 members that play 16 distinct nights. None hops Balloon Boy at 5 s with the phone's vocals at 10, 15 and 20 s, and none agrees on 30 mask windows; the closest, one draw fewer at the start, agrees on 29 of 41 and plays echo1 at 15 s where the phone plays echo3b. None of the 14 seeds of the logcat bracket matches the opening audio either.
